title: Covariance squared is bounded by the product of variances, given a positive variance
statement: For random variables X, Y over a distribution (p, n): if 0 < variance(X, p, n) then covariance(X,Y,p,n)^2 <= variance(X,p,n) * variance(Y,p,n) -- the Cauchy-Schwarz bound for covariance, positive-variance case.

formal.statement: theorem Rat.covariance_sq_le_variance_mul_of_pos : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> Rat)) -> ((x1 : ((x1 : AxNat) -> Rat)) -> ((x2 : ((x2 : AxNat) -> Rat)) -> ((x3 : AxNat) -> ((x4 : Rat.IsDistribution x2 x3) -> ((x5 : Rat.lt Rat.zero (Rat.variance x0 x2 x3)) -> Rat.le (Rat.mul (Rat.covariance x0 x1 x2 x3) (Rat.covariance x0 x1 x2 x3)) (Rat.mul (Rat.variance x0 x2 x3) (Rat.variance x1 x2 x3))))))))
